description: MoltEvo skill A/B and learning-curve suite v2 (deterministic graders): target skill among all other skills plus distractors, negative-transfer tasks, explicit/implicit/one-off learning.

commit-style.description: Commit message convention for this repository
commit-style.instructions: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits with a scope: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`, e.g. `feat(calc): add sub`. Types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore.

answer-style.description: How to format explanations of code
answer-style.instructions: When explaining code, always end the answer with a final line that starts with `TL;DR:` followed by a one-sentence summary.

python-docstrings.description: Docstring rules for new Python functions
python-docstrings.instructions: Every new Python function must have a Google-style docstring with an `Args:` section and a `Returns:` section.

license-header.description: License header for new source files
license-header.when_to_use: creating a new Python file or module
license-header.instructions: Every new Python file must start with the exact first line `# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT`.

run-tests.description: How to run this project's tests
run-tests.instructions: This project uses a src/ layout. Run tests with `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q`; plain `pytest` fails with ImportError.

project-layout.when_to_use: adding a new module or Python file
project-layout.instructions: All application modules live under `src/app/`. Never create Python modules in the repository root.

logging-convention.description: How to report problems in application code
logging-convention.instructions: Report problems with the project logger: `from app.log import log`, then `log.error(...)` or `log.warning(...)`. Never use print() for diagnostics.

changelog-policy.instructions: Every code change must add a bullet under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md describing the change.

gen-script.instructions: tools/gen.py only works with the environment variable GEN_MODE=fast, e.g. `GEN_MODE=fast python tools/gen.py`. Without it, it fails with an unhelpful error.

timezone-tests.instructions: The test suite must be run with TZ=UTC, e.g. `TZ=UTC python -m pytest -q`.

slow-tests.instructions: Some tests are marked slow and take minutes. Run the suite with `python -m pytest -q -m 'not slow'`.

app-entry.instructions: Run the app with `python -m app.cli`. `python -m app` is a deprecated entry point: it prints ok and exits successfully but generates nothing useful.

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from report import fmt

GOLDEN = Path(__file__).with_name('golden.txt')


def test_report_matches_golden():
    got = '\n'.join(fmt(ts) for ts in (0, 86400, 1700000000))
    assert got == GOLDEN.read_text().strip()

react-components.instructions: Use function components with hooks, one component per file, PascalCase file names.

sql-migrations.when_to_use: changing the database schema or adding tables
sql-migrations.instructions: Create a new numbered migration under migrations/. Never edit a migration that has already been applied.

docker-build.when_to_use: building or changing the Docker image
docker-build.instructions: Use multi-stage builds, pin base images by digest, and run the final image as a non-root user.

api-error-format.description: Error format for HTTP API endpoints
api-error-format.instructions: Return JSON {"error": {"code": ..., "message": ...}} with the matching HTTP status code.

release-process.when_to_use: preparing a release or bumping the version
release-process.instructions: Bump the version in pyproject.toml, move the Unreleased entries in CHANGELOG.md under the new version, then tag vX.Y.Z.

python-test-style.description: How to write new Python tests
python-test-style.when_to_use: writing or adding new Python tests
python-test-style.instructions: Use plain pytest functions (no unittest classes), name files test_<module>.py, one behavior per test.

data-files.when_to_use: editing CSV or JSON files under the data/ directory
data-files.instructions: Files under data/ are generated. Never edit them by hand; regenerate them with `make data`.

code-review.when_to_use: asked to review a diff or pull request
code-review.instructions: Check correctness, tests and naming. Reply with a bulleted list of comments grouped by file.
